title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc — race pages (UTMB, CCC, OCC, TDS, PTL) and UTMB World Series events page
claims: The UTMB race page labels the UTMB as the '100M Final of the UTMB World Series' in the 100M category.
The OCC race page labels OCC as the '50K Final of the UTMB World Series'.
The TDS race page lists 4 Running Stones and does not label TDS as a distance-category Final, while the UTMB, CCC and OCC pages each explicitly name their category Final.
The PTL race page states the PTL is run in teams of 2 or 3 'without any official ranking' and describes the PTL as setting itself apart from other races.
The UTMB, CCC, OCC and TDS race pages all sit inside the 24–30 August 2026 HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc week, and each race page publishes its own timing table and cut-off times.
The UTMB World Series events page states that Running Stones are collected by finishing a UTMB World Series Event or Major.
